claims.statement: The Mongolian death worm is a creature alleged to live in the Gobi Desert.
claims.statement_id: Cacing maut Mongolia adalah makhluk yang konon hidup di Gurun Gobi.
claims.quote: is a creature alleged to exist in the Gobi Desert.

claims.statement: Tales of it first reached the West through Roy Chapman Andrews's 1926 book On the Trail of Ancient Man.
claims.statement_id: Kisahnya pertama dikenal di Barat lewat buku Roy Chapman Andrews tahun 1926, On the Trail of Ancient Man.
claims.quote: Tales of the creature first came to Western attention as a result of Roy Chapman Andrews's 1926 book On the Trail of Ancient Man.

claims.statement: In that book Andrews quotes Mongolian prime minister Damdinbazar, who described the worm in 1922.
claims.statement_id: Dalam buku itu Andrews mengutip perdana menteri Mongolia Damdinbazar yang menggambarkan cacing ini pada 1922.
claims.quote: In On the Trail of Ancient Man, Andrews cites Mongolian prime minister Damdinbazar, who in 1922 described the worm

claims.statement: It is shaped like a sausage about two feet long, with no head or legs, and so poisonous that touching it means instant death.
claims.statement_id: Bentuknya seperti sosis sepanjang sekitar dua kaki, tanpa kepala dan kaki, dan begitu beracun sehingga menyentuhnya berarti mati seketika.
claims.quote: It is shaped like a sausage about two feet long, has no head nor legs and is so poisonous that merely to touch it means instant death.

claims.statement: Andrews himself did not believe the creature existed.
claims.statement_id: Andrews sendiri tidak percaya makhluk itu ada.
claims.quote: Andrews, however, did not believe in the creature's existence.

claims.statement: In 1983 a Tartar sand boa was shown to locals who said they had seen the olgoi-khorkhoi, and they confirmed it was the same animal.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1983 seekor ular boa pasir Tartar ditunjukkan kepada warga yang mengaku pernah melihat olgoi-khorkhoi, dan mereka membenarkan itulah hewannya.
claims.quote: In 1983, a specimen of Tartar sand boa (Eryx tataricus) was shown to locals who claimed to have seen "olgoi-khorkhoi" and they confirmed that this was the same animal.

claims.statement: The worm is described as fat and bright red, 0.6 to 1.5 metres long.
claims.statement_id: Cacing ini bertubuh gemuk, berwarna merah cerah, dan panjangnya 0,6 hingga 1,5 meter.
claims.quote: Cacing ini bertubuh gemuk dan berwarna merah cerah, memiliki panjang 0.6 hingga 1.5 meter.

claims.statement: Local Mongols claim the worm can spray acid and give off deadly electric shocks.
claims.statement_id: Penduduk Mongol setempat mengklaim cacing ini dapat menyemburkan asam dan mengeluarkan sengatan listrik yang mematikan manusia.
claims.quote: Cacing ini diklaim oleh penduduk Mongol setempat memiliki kemampuan menyebar asam dan mengeluarkan sengatan listrik yang akan membunuh manusia.

claims.statement: Because it resembles a cow's intestine, locals call it olgoi-khorkhoi, "intestine worm".
claims.statement_id: Karena mirip usus sapi, warga setempat menyebutnya olgoi-khorkhoi, "cacing usus".
claims.quote: 牛の腸に似ていることから、現地ではオルゴイホルホイ（olgoi-khorkhoi、モンゴル語: олгой-хорхой、腸虫の意）と呼ばれている。

claims.statement: Erlik is the god of death and the underworld in Turkic mythology, the underworld sometimes called Tamag (hell).
claims.statement_id: Erlik adalah dewa kematian dan dunia bawah dalam mitologi Turkik, yang kadang disebut Tamag (neraka).
claims.quote: is the god of death and the underworld, sometimes referred to as Tamag (hell) in Turkic mythology.

claims.statement: From the underworld Erlik sends death, plague and evil spirits to torment people and take their souls to his realm.
claims.statement_id: Dari dunia bawah, Erlik mendatangkan kematian, wabah, dan roh jahat untuk menyiksa manusia dan membawa jiwa mereka ke wilayahnya.
claims.quote: From the underworld, Erlik brings forth death, plague and evil spirits to torment humans and take their souls into his realm.

claims.statement: Erlik is already named in the Orkhon inscriptions and consistently appears as lord of the underworld in Turkic belief.
claims.statement_id: Erlik sudah disebut dalam prasasti Orkhon dan secara konsisten menjadi penguasa dunia bawah dalam kepercayaan Turkik.
claims.quote: Erlik has already been mentioned in the Orkhon writings and shows a consistent pattern as the lord of the underworld among Turkic belief systems.

claims.statement: In Mongolian he is called Erleg or Yerleg, and in Hungarian mythology his equivalent is Ördög.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Mongol ia disebut Erleg atau Yerleg, dan dalam mitologi Hungaria padanannya adalah Ördög.
claims.quote: In Mongolian, Erlik is referred to as Erleg or Yerleg, and in Hungarian mythology he is equivalent to Ördög.

claims.statement: Erlik took part in the creation of humanity, slew the messenger god Maidere and teaches sin; he is sometimes represented by a totemic bear.
claims.statement_id: Erlik terlibat dalam penciptaan manusia, membunuh dewa utusan Maidere, dan mengajarkan dosa; kadang ia dilambangkan dengan beruang totem.
claims.quote: In Turkic mythology, Erlik was involved in the creation of humanity. He slew the messenger-god, Maidere/Maydere, and is a teacher of sin. He is sometimes represented by a totemic bear.

claims.statement: Erlik is a brother of Ülgen; both were created by Kayra (Tengere Kayra Khan).
claims.statement_id: Erlik saudara Ülgen; keduanya diciptakan oleh Kayra (Tengere Kayra Khan).
claims.quote: Erlik is a brother of Ülgen, they both have been created from Kayra (Tengere Kayra Khan) the god of it.

claims.statement: Erlik is held to cause sickness and death and to judge the dead, ruling from a castle at the deepest point of the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Erlik dianggap penyebab penyakit dan kematian serta hakim bagi orang mati, yang memerintah dari sebuah istana di titik terdalam dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Erlik gilt als Ursache von Krankheit und Tod, und als Richter über die Verstorbenen in der Unterwelt. Über jene Unterwelt regierte Erlik in deren tiefstem Punkt in einem Schloss.

claims.statement: In Altai myth Erlik was the first human to die, as a result of trying to claim divinity, and descended to the realm of the dead to become its ruler.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitos Altai, Erlik adalah manusia pertama yang mati, akibat usahanya mengklaim keilahian, lalu turun ke alam orang mati dan menjadi penguasanya.
claims.quote: Dem altaischen Mythos zur Folge war Erlik der erste Mensch, der starb, eine Konsequenz seines Versuches, Göttlichkeit für sich zu beanspruchen, und somit in das Totenreich hinabstieg, wo er zu dessen Herrscher wurde.

claims.statement: In North Caucasian and Turkic folklore the almas (alma, almasty) is a cryptid said to live in the Caucasus, the Tian Shan and Pamir Mountains of Central Asia, and the Altai Mountains of western Mongolia.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Kaukasus Utara dan Turkik, almas (alma, almasty) adalah kriptid yang konon menghuni Kaukasus, Tian Shan, dan Pegunungan Pamir di Asia Tengah, serta Pegunungan Altai di Mongolia barat.
claims.quote: In North Caucasian and Turkic folklore, an almas, alma or almasty, is a cryptid said to inhabit the Caucasus, Tian Shan and Pamir Mountains of Central Asia, and the Altai Mountains of western Mongolia.

claims.statement: The term almas and many variants appear in Mongolian, Turkic and Iranian languages.
claims.statement_id: Istilah almas dan banyak variannya muncul dalam bahasa Mongol, Turkik, dan Iran.
claims.quote: The term "almas" and numerous variants thereof appear in Mongolian, Turkic languages, and Iranian languages.

claims.statement: Byambyn Rinchen remarked that the origin of the name Almas is quite unknown and hard to translate.
claims.statement_id: Byambyn Rinchen menyatakan asal-usul nama Almas sama sekali tidak diketahui dan sulit diterjemahkan.
claims.quote: commented that "the origin of the old name [Almas] is quite unknown ... and it does not lend itself for translation in other languages"

claims.statement: In Övörkhangai and Bayankhongor belief in the almas led to a taboo on its name, so it may be called akhai, 'uncle-brother'.
claims.statement_id: Di Övörkhangai dan Bayankhongor, kepercayaan pada almas melahirkan tabu menyebut namanya, sehingga mereka disebut akhai, "paman-saudara".
claims.quote: Folk belief in the almas in Övörkhangai and Bayankhongor has resulted in a name-avoidance taboo there, wherein the entities may be referred to as akhai, meaning 'uncle-brother'.

claims.statement: Darkhad tradition includes the deity Almas khara Tenguer, 'Almas the Black God', linked with highland prairies and mountain forests.
claims.statement_id: Tradisi Darkhad mengenal dewa Almas khara Tenguer, "Almas Dewa Hitam", yang dikaitkan dengan padang tinggi dan hutan gunung.
claims.quote: The folk traditions of Darkhad include the deity Almas khara Tenguer, meaning 'Almas the Black God' and associated with highland prairies and mountain forests.

claims.statement: The beings are said to reach two metres, with fur ranging from reddish brown to reddish black.
claims.statement_id: Almas konon setinggi hingga dua meter dengan tubuh berbulu berwarna cokelat kemerahan hingga hitam kemerahan.
claims.quote: Die Wesen sollen eine Größe von bis zu zwei Metern erreichen. Ihr Körper soll mit Fell bedeckt sein, dessen Farbschattierung von rotbraun bis rötlich-schwarz reichen soll.

claims.statement: They walk stooped on two legs and can run very fast.
claims.statement_id: Mereka berjalan membungkuk dengan dua kaki dan bisa berlari sangat cepat.
claims.quote: Sie sollen gebückt auf zwei Beinen laufen und sehr schnell werden können.

claims.statement: Tradition describes the almas as very shy and mainly nocturnal.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi, almas digambarkan sangat pemalu dan terutama aktif pada malam hari.
claims.quote: Almas werden in Überlieferungen als sehr scheu und hauptsächlich nachtaktiv beschrieben.

claims.statement: Another source says the name Almas is Mongolian and roughly means "wild man".
claims.statement_id: Menurut sumber lain, nama Almas berasal dari bahasa Mongol dan kira-kira berarti "manusia liar".
claims.quote: Der Name Almas (Алмас) stammt aus dem Mongolischen und kann in etwa als „Wildmensch“ oder „der Wilde“ übersetzt werden.

claims.statement: Asena is the name of a she-wolf in the foundation myth of the Göktürks.
claims.statement_id: Asena adalah nama serigala betina dalam mitos pendirian bangsa Göktürk.
claims.quote: Asena is the name of a she-wolf associated with the Göktürks' foundation myth.

claims.statement: The legend tells of a boy who survived a battle; a she-wolf finds the injured child and nurses him back to health.
claims.statement_id: Legenda Asena berkisah tentang seorang anak yang selamat dari pertempuran; seekor serigala betina menemukan dan merawatnya hingga sembuh.
claims.quote: The legend of Asena tells of a young boy who survived a battle; a female wolf finds the injured child and nurses him back to health.

claims.statement: The she-wolf, pregnant by the boy, crosses the Western Sea to a cave near the Qocho mountains and a Tocharian city and bears ten half-wolf, half-human boys.
claims.statement_id: Serigala itu hamil, menyeberangi Laut Barat menuju gua dekat pegunungan Qocho dan kota orang Tokharia, lalu melahirkan sepuluh anak laki-laki setengah serigala setengah manusia.
claims.quote: The she-wolf, impregnated by the boy, escapes her enemies by crossing the Western Sea to a cave near the Qocho mountains and a city of the Tocharians, giving birth to ten half-wolf, half-human boys.

claims.statement: One of them, Yizhi Nishidu, becomes their leader and founds the Ashina clan, which ruled the Göktürk and other Turkic nomadic empires.
claims.statement_id: Salah satunya, Yizhi Nishidu, menjadi pemimpin dan mendirikan klan Ashina yang memerintah Göktürk dan kekaisaran nomaden Turkik lainnya.
claims.quote: Of these, Yizhi Nishidu becomes their leader and establishes the Ashina clan, which ruled over the Göktürk and other Turkic nomadic empires.

claims.statement: With the rise of Turkish ethnic nationalism in the 1930s, reverence for Turkic mythological figures such as Bozkurt, Asena and Ergenekon revived.
claims.statement_id: Dengan bangkitnya nasionalisme etnis Turki pada 1930-an, pemujaan tokoh mitologi Turkik seperti Bozkurt, Asena, dan Ergenekon kembali hidup.
claims.quote: With the rise of Turkish ethnic nationalism in the 1930s, the veneration of figures of Turkic Mythology, such as Bozkurt, Asena and Ergenekon resurged.

claims.statement: The oldest mention is in the records of the Northern Zhou dynasty (mid-sixth century).
claims.statement_id: Catatan tertua tentang legenda ini terdapat dalam kronik Dinasti Zhou Utara (pertengahan abad keenam).
claims.quote: Die älteste Erwähnung findet sich in den Aufzeichnungen der Nördlichen Zhou-Dynastie (Mitte des sechsten Jahrhunderts).

claims.statement: With one exception, every Chinese account of the Turks' descent gives a she-wolf a special role.
claims.statement_id: Kecuali satu, semua kisah Tiongkok tentang asal-usul bangsa Turk memberi peran khusus kepada seekor serigala betina.
claims.quote: Bis auf eine Ausnahme spielt in allen chinesischen Erzählungen zur Abstammung der Türken eine Wölfin eine besondere Rolle.

claims.statement: Tulpar is a legendary winged or celestial horse in Turkic mythology.
claims.statement_id: Tulpar adalah kuda bersayap atau kuda langit legendaris dalam mitologi Turkik.
claims.quote: Tulpar is a legendary winged or celestial horse in Turkic mythology.

claims.statement: Tulpar possibly arose from the way of life of Central Asian peoples, whose culture centred on hunting.
claims.statement_id: Tulpar mungkin lahir dari kehidupan masyarakat Asia Tengah yang budayanya berpusat pada perburuan.
claims.quote: El Tulpar surgió posiblemente a raíz de la naturaleza de las personas en Asia central, con una cultura centrada en torno a la caza.

claims.statement: Tulpar is part of the heritage of Turkic-speaking nations, including Turks, Uzbeks, Bashkirs, Kazakhs and Kyrgyz.
claims.statement_id: Tulpar menjadi warisan budaya bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turkik, termasuk Turki, Uzbek, Bashkir, Kazakh, dan Kirgiz.
claims.quote: Tulpar is embedded in the cultural heritage of Turkic-speaking nations, including Turks, Uzbeks, Bashkirs, Kazakhs and Kyrgyz.

claims.statement: Kazakhstan's emblem has two golden tulpars, a yurt top and sun rays on a blue field representing the sky where tulpars gallop.
claims.statement_id: Lambang negara Kazakhstan memuat dua tulpar emas, puncak yurt, dan sinar matahari di latar biru yang melambangkan langit tempat tulpar berlari.
claims.quote: The emblem of Kazakhstan includes two golden tulpars, a yurt's top, and sun rays on a blue background symbolizing the sky where tulpars gallop.

claims.statement: In Kyrgyz tales a tulpar is a horse able to fly with the hero on its back.
claims.statement_id: Dalam dongeng Kirgiz, tulpar adalah kuda yang mampu terbang sambil membawa sang pahlawan di punggungnya.
claims.quote: Dans les contes kirghizes, « tulpar » désigne un cheval capable de voler en portant le héros sur son dos.

claims.statement: Manas, hero of the Epic of Manas, must capture the tulpar Kak-Kula, suggesting a hunted rather than tamed animal.
claims.statement_id: Manas, pahlawan epos Manas, harus menangkap kuda tulpar Kak-Kula, yang menunjukkan hewan buruan alih-alih hewan jinak.
claims.quote: Manas, héros bien connu de l'épopée de Manas, doit capturer le cheval « tulpar » Kak-Kula, ce qui renvoie à un animal chassé plutôt que domestiqué.

claims.statement: This horse is said to correspond to Pegasus of Greek mythology.
claims.statement_id: Kuda ini disebut sepadan dengan Pegasus dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Ce cheval correspondrait au Pégase de la mythologie grecque.

claims.statement: Zilant is a legendary creature between a dragon and a wyvern in Tatar mythology.
claims.statement_id: Zilant adalah makhluk legendaris di antara naga dan wyvern dalam mitologi Tatar.
claims.quote: is a legendary creature, something between a dragon and a wyvern in Tatar mythology.

claims.statement: Since 1730 Zilant has been the official symbol of Kazan, capital of the Republic of Tatarstan in Russia, and this winged snake appears in legends of Kazan's founding.
claims.statement_id: Sejak 1730 Zilant menjadi lambang resmi Kazan, ibu kota Republik Tatarstan di Rusia, dan ular bersayap ini disebut dalam legenda pendirian Kazan.
claims.quote: Since 1730, it has been the official symbol of Kazan, the capital city of the Republic of Tatarstan in Russia. This winged snake is mentioned in legends about the foundation of Kazan.

claims.statement: The Zilant is a fabulous winged snake with the forepart of a dragon, part of Tatar and Russian folklore.
claims.statement_id: Zilant adalah makhluk dongeng berupa ular bersayap dengan bagian depan seekor naga, bagian dari cerita rakyat Tatar dan Rusia.
claims.quote: ist als geflügelte Schlange mit dem Vorderteil eines Drachen ein Fabelwesen, das ein Teil der tatarischen und russischen Folklore ist.

claims.statement: The word Zilant transcribes Russian Зилант, itself from Tatar yılan, "snake".
claims.statement_id: Kata Zilant adalah transkripsi Inggris dari bahasa Rusia Зилант, yang berasal dari kata Tatar yılan, "ular".
claims.quote: The word Zilant is the English transcription of Russian Зилант, itself a rendering of Tatar yılan/елан

claims.statement: Tatars saw it as a repulsive creature like the European and Persian dragon; in Idel-Ural belief any snake that lives 100 years becomes an ajdaha.
claims.statement_id: Orang Tatar menganggapnya makhluk menjijikkan yang sepadan dengan naga Eropa dan Persia; menurut kepercayaan Idel-Ural, ular yang hidup 100 tahun berubah menjadi ajdaha.
claims.quote: Tatars regarded it as a repulsive creature, corresponding to European and Persian dragon. According to Idel-Ural beliefs, any snake that survives for 100 years turns into an ajdaha.

claims.statement: The Zilant differs from Aq Yılan ('White Snake'), the king of snakes.
claims.statement_id: Zilant berbeda dari Aq Yılan ("Ular Putih"), raja para ular.
claims.quote: The Zilant/Ajdaha differs from Aq Yılan ('White Snake'), which is the king of snakes.

claims.statement: Despite its bird-like posture, the Zilant differs from the basilisk in having a dragon's head, not a bird's.
claims.statement_id: Meski posturnya mirip burung, Zilant berbeda dari basilisk karena kepalanya kepala naga, bukan kepala burung.
claims.quote: Vom Basilisk unterscheidet er sich trotz seiner vogelähnlichen Haltung durch den Kopf, der ein Drachen- und kein Vogelkopf ist

claims.statement: The abasy are demons in the mythology of the Sakha, or Yakuts.
claims.statement_id: Abasy adalah iblis dalam mitologi orang Sakha atau Yakut.
claims.quote: are demons in the mythology of the Sakha (also known as the Yakuts).

claims.statement: The abaasy occupy the lower level of the universe, the underworld or "kingdom of darkness".
claims.statement_id: Abaasy menempati lapisan bawah alam semesta, yaitu dunia bawah atau "kerajaan kegelapan".
claims.quote: The abaasy occupy the lower level, referred to as the underworld or "kingdom of darkness."

claims.statement: The abaasy are said to be spirits of the long dead who live near graves or in deserted places or roam causing destruction.
claims.statement_id: Abaasy konon roh orang yang sudah lama meninggal, yang tinggal dekat kuburan atau tempat sepi, atau berkeliling membuat kerusakan.
claims.quote: The abaasy are alleged to be the spirits of the long deceased, who dwell near graves or in deserted places, or who otherwise travel about causing destruction.

claims.statement: They serve Arson-Duolai, ruler of the dead, who swallows souls and gives the living diseases; the abaasy can be appeased with blood sacrifices.
claims.statement_id: Mereka melayani Arson-Duolai, penguasa orang mati yang menelan jiwa dan memberi penyakit kepada orang hidup; abaasy dapat ditenangkan dengan persembahan darah.
claims.quote: They serve Arson-Duolai, the ruler of the dead, who also swallows people's souls and gives the living diseases. The abaasy can be appeased by blood sacrifices.

claims.statement: The abaasy are described as one-eyed, one-armed, one-legged monsters riding two-headed, eight-legged, two-tailed dragons.
claims.statement_id: Abaasy digambarkan sebagai monster bermata satu, berlengan satu, dan berkaki satu yang menunggang naga berkepala dua, berkaki delapan, dan berekor dua.
claims.quote: The abbasy are described as "one-eyed, one-armed, one-legged" monsters mounted on "two-headed, eight-legged, two-tailed dragons as steeds."

claims.statement: In the Olonkho epics they are hideous man-eaters; their chief Alyp Khara Aat Mogoidoon is a three-headed, six-armed, six-legged giant with an iron body.
claims.statement_id: Dalam syair epos Olonkho mereka makhluk buruk rupa pemakan manusia; pemimpinnya, Alyp Khara Aat Mogoidoon, raksasa berkepala tiga, berlengan enam, berkaki enam, dan bertubuh besi.
claims.quote: In the Olonkho epic poems they are ugly and horrible man-eating beings. Their chief Alyp Khara Aat Mogoidoon is a three-headed, six-armed and six-legged giant with a body made of iron.

claims.statement: They are giant beings with iron teeth who live in the underworld and travel in groups of seven.
claims.statement_id: Mereka makhluk raksasa bergigi besi yang menghuni dunia bawah dan bepergian dalam kelompok tujuh.
claims.quote: Es sind gigantische Wesen mit Zähnen aus Eisen und bewohnen im Weltbild der Jakuten die Unterwelt. Sie reisen in Gruppen von Sieben.

claims.statement: Hence the Yakut phrase abaahy kör- ('to see abaasy') means to hate or loathe.
claims.statement_id: Karena itu, ungkapan Yakut abaahy kör- ("melihat abaasy") berarti membenci atau jijik.
claims.quote: Aufgrund dessen bedeutet im jakutischen абааһы көр- (Abaasy sehen) so viel wie hassen oder verabscheuen.

claims.statement: Al Basty or Al Kardai is an ancient female spirit, the personification of guilt, in folklore across the Caucasus, with origins traced back to Sumerian mythology.
claims.statement_id: Al Basty atau Al Kardai adalah roh perempuan kuno, personifikasi rasa bersalah, dalam cerita rakyat di seluruh Pegunungan Kaukasus, dengan asal-usul yang ditarik hingga mitologi Sumeria.
claims.quote: or Al Kardai is an ancient female spirit, the personification of guilt, found in folklore throughout the Caucasus mountains, with origins going as far back as Sumerian mythology.

claims.statement: In Turkic languages al means red and bastı means pressure or pressing.
claims.statement_id: Dalam bahasa Turkik, al berarti merah dan bastı berarti tekanan atau menekan.
claims.quote: Al means red, and bastı means pressure or pressing in Turkic languages.

claims.statement: One variant of the Al Basti myth is traced to Sumerian times as one of the names of Lilith.
claims.statement_id: Satu versi mitos Al Basti ditarik hingga zaman Sumeria sebagai salah satu nama Lilith.
claims.quote: A variation of the Al Basti myth stretches back into Sumerian times as one of the names given to Lilith.

claims.statement: In Turkic folklore Al Basti is often confused with the mare, the succubus and Middle Eastern female spirits that enter men's erotic dreams.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Turkik, Al Basti sering dikacaukan dengan mare, sukubus, dan roh perempuan Timur Tengah yang memasuki mimpi erotis lelaki.
claims.quote: In Turkic folklore Al Basti has been often confused as both a Mare, a Succubus, as well as any number of Middle Eastern female spirits which are told to enter a man's erotic dreams.

claims.statement: The difference is that in the Al Basti legends she is not a sexual spirit.
claims.statement_id: Bedanya, dalam legenda Al Basti ia bukan roh seksual.
claims.quote: the difference in the Al Basti legends is that she is not a sexual spirit

claims.statement: Albasty are evil female spirits in the mythology of Turkic and some neighbouring peoples.
claims.statement_id: Albasty adalah roh perempuan jahat dalam mitologi bangsa Turkik dan beberapa bangsa tetangganya.
claims.quote: злые женские духи в мифологии тюркских и некоторых соседних с ними народов.

claims.statement: She is usually pictured as an ugly naked woman with long loose yellow hair and sagging breasts.
claims.statement_id: Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai perempuan telanjang buruk rupa dengan rambut kuning panjang tergerai dan payudara menggantung.
claims.quote: Обычно представляется в виде уродливой обнажённой женщины с длинными распущенными жёлтыми волосами и обвислыми грудями.

claims.statement: She appears in dreams and smothers people by pressing on the chest.
claims.statement_id: Ia muncul dalam mimpi dan mencekik dengan menekan dada.
claims.quote: Является во снах и душит сдавливая грудь.

claims.statement: Şüräle is a forest spirit of Turkic, especially Tatar and Bashkir, mythology with long fingers, a horn on its forehead and a woolly body, who lures victims into thickets and can tickle them to death.
claims.statement_id: Şüräle adalah roh hutan dalam mitologi Turkik, terutama Tatar dan Bashkir: berjari panjang, bertanduk di dahi, berbulu lebat, dan memikat korban ke semak lalu menggelitikinya sampai mati.
claims.quote: is a forest spirit in Turkic mythology (especially Tatar and Bashkir). According to legends, Shurali lives in forests. He has long fingers, a horn on its forehead, and a woolly body. He lures victims into the thickets and can tickle them to death.

claims.statement: Şüräle closely resembles similar figures such as the Chuvash Arçuri, the Siberian Tatar Pitsen and the Ural Tatar Yarımtıq.
claims.statement_id: Şüräle sangat mirip tokoh lain seperti Arçuri dari Chuvash, Pitsen dari Tatar Siberia, dan Yarımtıq dari Tatar Ural.
claims.quote: Shurali closely resembles other similar characters from the folklore such as Arçuri of the Chuvash, Pitsen (Picen) of the Siberian Tatars and Yarımtıq of the Ural Tatars.

claims.statement: He can take many forms; as a human he looks like a peasant with glowing eyes and shoes on backwards.
claims.statement_id: Ia dapat berubah ke banyak wujud; sebagai manusia ia tampak seperti petani bermata menyala dengan sepatu terpasang terbalik.
claims.quote: He can shapeshift into many different forms. As a human, he looks like a peasant with glowing eyes, and his shoes are on backwards.

claims.statement: A person who befriends Şüräle can learn the secrets of magic.
claims.statement_id: Orang yang berteman dengan Şüräle dapat mempelajari rahasia sihir.
claims.quote: A person who befriends Şüräle can learn the secrets of magic.

claims.statement: Inspired by Tatar folklore, Ghabdulla Tuqay wrote the poem Şüräle.
claims.statement_id: Terinspirasi cerita rakyat Tatar, Ghabdulla Tuqay menulis puisi Şüräle.
claims.quote: Inspired by the Tatar folklore, Ghabdulla Tuqay wrote a poem Şüräle.

claims.statement: The first Tatar ballet, Farit Yarullin's Şüräle, was based on the poem.
claims.statement_id: Balet Tatar pertama, Şüräle karya Farit Yarullin, didasarkan pada puisi itu.
claims.quote: The first Tatar ballet by Farit Yarullin  Şüräle ... was based on the poem.

claims.statement: Şüräle is a humanlike mythical being in Tatar, Bashkir, Chuvash and Mari folklore, the personification of the forest spirit.
claims.statement_id: Şüräle makhluk mitos mirip manusia dalam cerita rakyat Tatar, Bashkir, Chuvash, dan Mari, personifikasi roh hutan.
claims.quote: антропоморфное мифическое существо, описанное в татарском, башкирском, чувашском и марийском фольклорах, персонификация духа леса.

claims.statement: Attitudes toward it are mixed: honoured as the forest spirit, or hated as a quarrelsome creature that attacks people.
claims.statement_id: Sikap orang terhadapnya mendua: dihormati sebagai roh hutan, atau dibenci sebagai makhluk suka berkonflik yang menyerang manusia.
claims.quote: Имеет к себе двойственное отношение, либо почитаем, как дух леса, либо же ненавидим, как слишком конфликтное существо, нападающее на людей.

claims.statement: Archura is a shapeshifting woodland spirit of Turkic mythology who protects wild animals and forests.
claims.statement_id: Archura adalah roh hutan pengubah wujud dalam mitologi Turkik yang melindungi satwa liar dan hutan.
claims.quote: is a shapeshifting woodland spirit in Turkic mythology who protects wild animals and forests.

claims.statement: Archura usually appears as a man but can change size from a blade of grass to a very tall tree; his hair and beard are living grass, and he sometimes has a tail, hooves and horns.
claims.statement_id: Archura biasanya tampil sebagai lelaki, tetapi dapat mengubah ukurannya dari sehelai rumput hingga pohon yang sangat tinggi; rambut dan janggutnya dari rumput hidup, dan kadang ia berekor, berkuku, dan bertanduk.
claims.quote: Archura usually appears as a man, but he is able to change his size from that of a blade of grass to a very tall tree. He has hair and a beard made from living grass, and is sometimes depicted with a tail, hooves, and horns.

claims.statement: Archura has a close bond with the grey wolf.
claims.statement_id: Archura memiliki ikatan erat dengan serigala abu-abu.
claims.quote: Archura has a close bond with the gray wolf.

claims.statement: He protects the forest's animals and birds and tells them when to migrate.
claims.statement_id: Ia melindungi hewan dan burung hutan serta memberi tahu kapan mereka harus bermigrasi.
claims.quote: Archura protects the animals and birds in the forest and tells them when to migrate.

claims.statement: Archuras can mimic the voices of people wanderers know, lure them to their caves and tickle them to death.
claims.statement_id: Archura dapat meniru suara orang yang dikenal pengembara, memikat mereka ke gua, lalu menggelitiki mereka sampai mati.
claims.quote: can imitate voices of people familiar to wanderers and lure them back to their caves, where the Archuras will tickle them to death

claims.statement: They are not evil: though they enjoy misleading people and kidnapping young women, they also keep grazing cattle from straying too far into the forest.
claims.statement_id: Mereka tidak jahat: meski suka menyesatkan manusia dan menculik perempuan muda, mereka juga menjaga ternak agar tidak tersesat jauh ke hutan.
claims.quote: They aren't evil: although they enjoy misguiding humans and kidnapping young women, they are also known to keep grazing cattle from wandering too far into the forests and getting lost.

claims.statement: In Chuvash mythology the Archura (arzyuri) is a humanlike mythical being, the spirit and master of the forest.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Chuvash, Archura (arzyuri) makhluk mitos mirip manusia, roh penguasa hutan.
claims.quote: антропоморфное мифическое существо в чувашской мифологии; дух, хозяин леса.

claims.statement: The Chuvash name ar-ҫurri means "half human".
claims.statement_id: Nama Chuvash ar-ҫurri berarti "setengah manusia".
claims.quote: Таким образом, ар-ҫурри означает «наполовину человек»

claims.statement: Yuxa is a legendary creature of Turkic mythology; in popular belief every 100-year-old snake becomes a Yuxa, and in fairy tales it is a beautiful maiden who marries men to have children.
claims.statement_id: Yuxa adalah makhluk legendaris mitologi Turkik; menurut kepercayaan, setiap ular berusia 100 tahun berubah menjadi Yuxa, dan dalam dongeng ia gadis cantik yang menikahi lelaki untuk memperoleh keturunan.
claims.quote: is a legendary creature in Turkic mythology. According to popular beliefs, every 100-year-old snake is transformed into Yuxa. In fairy tales, Yuxa is described as a beautiful damsel who would marry men to beget offspring.

claims.statement: Yuxa has a dragon's head said to breathe fire or bite venomously, a reptilian body, two legs (sometimes none) and a barbed tail.
claims.statement_id: Yuxa berkepala naga yang konon menyemburkan api atau bergigitan berbisa, bertubuh reptil, berkaki dua (kadang tanpa kaki), dan berekor berduri.
claims.quote: Yuxa is a legendary creature with a dragon's head, which may be said to breathe fire or possess a venomous bite, a reptilian body, two legs (sometimes none), and a barbed tail.

claims.statement: It can become a handsome young man or beautiful young woman to seduce, protect or frighten people as it pleases.
claims.statement_id: Ia dapat menjelma pemuda tampan atau gadis cantik untuk menggoda, melindungi, atau menakuti orang sesukanya.
claims.quote: It can turn into handsome young men and beautiful young women to seduce, protect or terrify the people around them as their whim dictates.

claims.statement: In Bashkir and Tatar mythology Yuxa is an evil demon linked with water.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Bashkir dan Tatar, Yuxa adalah iblis jahat yang berhubungan dengan unsur air.
claims.quote: злой демон в башкирской и татарской мифологии. Связан с водной стихией.

claims.statement: Yuxa appears in fairy tales, the epic Ural-batyr and folk beliefs.
claims.statement_id: Tokoh Yuxa muncul dalam dongeng, epos Ural-batyr, dan kepercayaan rakyat.
claims.quote: Персонаж Юха встречается в сказках, эпосе «Урал-батыр», народных поверьях и др.

claims.statement: In other beliefs, an ajdaha that lives 500 to 1000 years turns into a Yuxa.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan lain, ajdaha yang hidup 500 hingga 1000 tahun berubah menjadi Yuxa.
claims.quote: По поверьям, в Юха превращается аждаха, доживший до 500—1000 лет

claims.statement: Bashkir keeps figurative expressions with Yuxa, such as yukha yylan for a treacherous person.
claims.statement_id: Bahasa Bashkir menyimpan ungkapan terkait Yuxa, misalnya yukha yylan untuk orang licik.
claims.quote: В башкирском языке сохранились образные выражения, связанные с Юхой: «юха йылан» (коварный человек)

claims.statement: Bai Baianai is the Yakut spirit of forests and animals and patron of hunters; hunters light fires and pray for a fruitful, accident-free hunt.
claims.statement_id: Bai Baianai adalah roh hutan dan hewan dalam kepercayaan Yakut serta pelindung para pemburu; pemburu menyalakan api dan berdoa agar buruannya berhasil tanpa celaka.
claims.quote: is the Yakut spirit of forests, animals and patron of hunters. Hunters light fires and pray that their work will pass fertile and without accidents.

claims.statement: In some cultures she protects children and is seen as a protector of the lineage.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian budaya ia melindungi anak-anak dan dianggap pelindung garis keturunan.
claims.quote: In some cultures, she protects children. She is considered a protector of the lineage.

claims.statement: In ancient times Baianai was the Turkic goddess of wildlife, wealth and fertility, worshipped across Altai and Sakha.
claims.statement_id: Pada zaman kuno Baianai adalah dewi Turkik untuk satwa liar, kekayaan, dan kesuburan, yang dipuja di wilayah Altai dan Sakha.
claims.quote: Baianai in ancient times was the Turkic goddess of wildlife, wealth and fertility. She was worshipped throughout what is now called as Altai and Sakha.

claims.statement: Her name means "rich, fertile, wealthy", and she was the daughter of Kayra.
claims.statement_id: Namanya berarti "kaya, subur, makmur", dan ia putri Kayra.
claims.quote: Her name means "rich, fertile, wealthy". She was the daughter of Kayra.

claims.statement: Bai Baianai is the goddess of hunting.
claims.statement_id: Bai Baianai adalah dewi perburuan.
claims.quote: Bai Baianai: Goddess of hunting.

claims.statement: Tagh Baianai is the goddess of forests.
claims.statement_id: Tagh Baianai adalah dewi hutan.
claims.quote: Tagh Baianai: Goddess of forests.

claims.statement: Ughu Baianai is the goddess of fishing.
claims.statement_id: Ughu Baianai adalah dewi perikanan.
claims.quote: Ughu Baianai: Goddess of fishery.

claims.statement: Another source describes Baianai as a jolly, noisy old man living in the forest, rich in furs.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menggambarkan Baianai sebagai lelaki tua yang riang dan riuh, tinggal di hutan dan kaya akan bulu binatang.
claims.quote: Это живущий в лесу веселый шумливый старик, богатый мехами.

claims.statement: Offerings were made to Baay Bayanay before a hunt, after a big catch or during long runs of bad luck.
claims.statement_id: Persembahan diberikan kepada Baay Bayanay sebelum berburu, setelah tangkapan besar, atau saat lama gagal berburu.
claims.quote: Баай Байанаю приносились жертвоприношения: перед началом охоты, в случае большой добычи или при длительных охотничьих неудачах.
